brief.product_or_service: A mobile language-practice app with beginner lessons and short guided speaking sessions
brief.campaign_goal: Increase app downloads among adult beginners
brief.target_audience: Adults who are new to a language and want to build a consistent practice habit around work and other commitments
brief.key_message: Short, guided speaking sessions make it easier to fit language practice into a daily routine

creative.headline: A few minutes can start a new habit
creative.primary_text: New language, busy schedule? Make room for a short practice session whenever it suits you. Beginner lessons and guided speaking activities help you keep showing up, one day at a time. Download the app and begin at your own pace.
creative.description: Short guided sessions designed for everyday practice.
